description: Disposal of scrap metals available in the Department of Sri Lanka Railways
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited under the National Competitive Bidding Procedure for the disposal of scrap metal in the Department of Sri Lanka Railways. Eleven (11) bidders have submitted bids for the same. Based on the recommendation of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee, approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-12-10 for the disposal of scrap metal related to several items. Accordingly, taking into account the recommendations made by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, based on the quotations agreed upon the negotiations conducted with M/s S.R. Steel (Pvt) Ltd., the substantially responsive highest bidder in respect of 04 more scrap metal items, the proposal submitted by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to dispose scrap metal items to M/s S.R. Steel (Pvt) Ltd, for a sum of Rs.114.51 million, was approved by the Cabinet.
